rows.en: (I came to the pool with Yuuto today!)

Did I keep you waiting?
Sorry, sorry.

It's fine, don't worry about it.
Well then, let's go swim.

Phew, let's take a break.
I'm kind of tired.
Come on, that's pathetic.
You're just too amazing, Yuuto...
Then you go ahead and rest.
I'm going to swim a bit more!
Go for it~
(I came to the pool with Kagura-kun today.)

Phew, can we take a break?
I'm kind of tired.
You're just too amazing, Kagura-kun...

(I'm swimming at the pool with Yuuto
again today!)

\p.
Did I keep you waiting?
Nah, I just got here.
I see... Well then, let's go swim.

You're as fast as ever, Yuuto.
I can't fall behind!

Haha, you look like you're
in good form today too.
Losing all the time gets on my nerves.
Then how about a race?

Loser treats the winner to a meal.
How about it!?
All right, I'm not gonna lose!

(I came to the pool with Kagura-kun
again today.)
Nope, I just got here too.

Same old Kagura-kun.
I can't fall behind either.
rows.notes: Female line omits 'fast' (male c07371 has it); kept as 'same as ever'.

rows.en: I'm sick of losing all the time.

I'm technically a girl, you know,
so give me a handicap!

(I'm hanging out at the park
with Yuuto today!)
Oh, you're here, \p.
Sorry to keep you waiting, Yuuto.
Well then, shall we take a little walk?

Being in Central Park is kind of
soothing, isn't it?
Yeah. Maybe because the air's so good?

Who knows. Thanks to negative ions, maybe?
Not that I know if they actually do anything...

Well, if it's soothing,
that's all that matters.
Well then, shall we head home for today?

(I'm hanging out at the park
with Kagura-kun today~)
Sorry to keep you waiting, Kagura-kun.

(I'm hanging out at the park
with Yuuto again today!)

Oh, you're finally here,
\p.
Sorry I kept you waiting.
Nah, I only just got here myself.

Looks like they rent out bikes,
so let's go cycling today.
Y-Yuuto, you're going way too fast...

Am I?
I thought I was pedaling like I always do...
...Just how fast do you usually go?
Well, cycling wasn't bad either.
Yeah, it was fun!

(I'm hanging out at the park
with Kagura-kun again today.)
Sorry I kept you waiting!
K-Kagura-kun, you're going way too fast...
...Just how fast do you usually go...?

(I came to the Battle Frontier's simulator
with Yuuto today!)

\p.
Are you ready!?

Looks like I'll need a bit longer, so first,
let me see what you can do, Yuuto.
rows.notes: The player is not ready yet.

rows.en: But are you okay in your regular clothes?
There's a bit of a reason for that...
Anyway, just watch me fly.
Your moves are surprisingly orthodox.
Surprisingly?
What do you take me for?

Well, you're usually kind of...
eccentric, I guess...
...Am I?

Oh well...
Now it's your turn!
All right, I'll give it my all!

(I came to the Battle Frontier's simulator
with Kagura-kun today.)

Sorry, I think I'll need a bit longer...
So first, let me see what you can do,
Kagura-kun.

Your moves are surprisingly orthodox,
Kagura-kun.

(I came to the simulator
with Yuuto again today!)
Yeah. Mind if I go first today?
Got it. I'll navigate from over here.
Well then, good luck.
Phew, how was that?
You kind of fight like Gary-sensei.

I guess you really do end up like
the person who teaches you.

I'd really like you to copy
my style too, though.

Then how about you show me
your technique, Yuuto?

(I came to the simulator
with Kagura-kun again today.)
Yeah. Mind if I go first today?
Phew, how was that?
